name: Niewiadów Polska Grupa Militarna S.A.
summary: Niewiadów Polska Grupa Militarna S.A. operates in the defense sector in Poland and the European Union. The company engages in the production of military products; development of modern drones, including unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) under the ReconSky name, unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) under the ReconPatrol name, and unmanned surface vessels (USVs) under the ReconSea name; and operation of a research and development center for testing applications. It also provides ammunition components, such as mortar and artillery rounds in calibers; mines and engineering equipment; transportation services; ammunition, such as rifles; weapons and combat equipment; product testing and backpack assembly …
